candidates.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
candidates.rationale: Both help consumers find people, reconnect with old classmates, and discover social contacts. Facebook's searchable profiles and social connections resemble Ark's people-discovery use case, although search is only one feature of Meta's broader social platforms.
candidates.similarities: Consumer-oriented people discovery | Searchable personal profiles and social connections | Reconnecting with classmates and friends
candidates.differences: People search is a feature rather than Meta's standalone business | Meta primarily monetizes advertising across social and messaging platforms | Much larger and more geographically diversified

candidates.name: Alphabet Inc.
candidates.rationale: Both operate search services that help users locate information, including people and their public profiles. Google's core search business matches Ark's search-engine format, but it serves general information needs rather than specializing in classmates, friends, and business contacts.
candidates.similarities: Consumer-facing search engines | Discovery of people and publicly accessible profiles | Technology-driven information retrieval
candidates.differences: People discovery is a narrow use case within Google's general-purpose search engine | Alphabet also operates substantial non-search businesses | Far greater scale than a Series A startup

candidates.name: Hello Group Inc.
candidates.rationale: Both help consumers discover people and form social connections. Hello Group's Momo platform emphasizes meeting new people, making it adjacent to Ark's friend discovery, but it is a social and entertainment service rather than a people-search engine.
candidates.similarities: Consumer social discovery | Profile-based discovery of other users | Facilitating new personal connections
candidates.differences: Emphasizes meeting strangers, dating, and live entertainment rather than finding existing contacts | Monetizes live video and value-added services rather than a standalone search product | Primarily serves China rather than the United States
